Trial credits expired 2026-01-31; no token activity in Feb. Sales attempted rescue email (2026-02-10) offering optimizer profile and batching tips; response: "we're leaning to OpenAI for now, cheaper for our volume." Security: required audit logs and SOC2 evidence; ok with hosted API if audit log retention option available. Notes are fragmentary — devs said SDK integration was smooth but finance pulled back. POC never advanced to canary. Recommended play: targeted cost comparison, auto-batching guide, one-week trial extension with 30% extra credits and a short perf-tuning session.
